name: SNNC ferronickel smelter, Gwangyang
production: RKEF ferronickel smelter treating New Caledonian saprolite; second line inaugurated March 2015 lifted capacity to ~54,000 t/yr Ni in ferronickel. Under a 2023 agreement SNNC is to shift part of output to matte, eventually ~26,000 t ferronickel + ~21,000 t matte, all sold to POSCO.
capacity: ~54,000 t/yr Ni contained in ferronickel; planned split ~26 kt ferronickel + ~21 kt matte
source: SMSP (JV partner) corporate disclosure on SNNC, accessed 2026

name: POSCO high-purity nickel refinery, Gwangyang
production: Wet refining route upgrading ~75% Ni matte to >99.9% high-purity nickel for battery use. STATUS DETAIL: groundbreaking Oct 2022 with stated target completion in H2 2023; operational status as of 2026 NOT verified here.
capacity: 20,000 t/yr high-purity nickel; POSCO notes this equates to ~91,000 t/yr on a nickel sulfate weight basis (1 t battery nickel sulfate ≈ 223 kg Ni). Investment ~KRW 230bn
source: POSCO Newsroom press release (Oct 2022)

name: POSCO Future M Gwangyang precursor plant
production: Ternary precursor (pCAM) plant completed with 45,000 t/yr capacity, built inside the existing Gwangyang cathode-material plant site; company says all precursor output goes to cathode material for Ultium Cells, and states this volume is enough for ~500,000 EVs. ~700 staff across the cathode + precursor plants.
capacity: 45,000 t/yr ternary precursor (pCAM)
source: POSCO Newsroom press release, Gwangyang precursor plant completion ceremony
